documents.title: University of Maryland, Baltimore Artificial Intelligence (AI) Guidelines
documents.summary: University-wide guidelines for faculty, students, researchers and administrators. They set no student-use rule and hand course decisions to instructors, while setting firm rules on data protection, approved tools, detectors and disclosure. Most content concerns privacy, HIPAA/FERPA, research and administrative use.
